clue.text: One that's elevated site of seaside entertainment, we hear

explanation.walkthrough: The surface makes 'elevated' describe the seaside pier on its stilts; in fact it defines a person raised to the House of Lords.
explanation.definitionFit: A British lord is said to be elevated to the peerage, so a member of the nobility is one raised in rank.

clue.text: Witness watching a Lord's match, say

clue.text: Step made unstable in headlong rush by a crowd
